name: groq
label: Groq
description: Use Groq's fast language models and audio processing capabilities.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open [console.groq.com/keys](https://console.groq.com/keys).
2. Click **Create API Key**, name it, and copy it.

ask-ai.label: Ask AI
ask-ai.description: Send a question or instruction to a Groq model and get a text reply.

model.label: Model
model.description: Speech models are left out; use the audio actions for them.

prompt.label: Question
prompt.description: What you want the model to answer or do.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: From 0 to 2. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.

maxTokens.label: Maximum Tokens
maxTokens.description: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.

topP.label: Top P
topP.description: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.

frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency Penalty
frequencyPenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Groq models do not support this yet.

presencePenalty.label: Presence Penalty
presencePenalty.description: From -2 to 2. Groq models do not support this yet.

memoryKey.label: Conversation Memory ID
memoryKey.description: Runs that share this ID continue one conversation. Empty: no memory.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: Messages sent before the question, such as a system instruction.

groq_create_response.label: Create Response
groq_create_response.description: Generate a model response with the Responses API.

modelId.label: Model
modelId.description: Groq model ID, e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Use List Models to find the IDs on this account.

input.label: Input
input.description: The text the model responds to. For a list of input items, leave this empty and set "input" in Additional Fields.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.description: A system message placed first in the model context.

maxOutputTokens.label: Max Output Tokens
maxOutputTokens.description: Upper limit on generated tokens, reasoning included.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature from 0 to 2. Lower is more focused. Defaults to 1.

topP.label: Top P
topP.description: Nucleus sampling from 0 to 1. Set this or Temperature, not both.

reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoningEffort.description: For reasoning models only: low, medium or high.

jsonSchema.label: JSON Schema
jsonSchema.description: Forces a JSON reply matching this schema, as {"name": "...", "schema": {...}, "strict": true}. Leave empty for plain text.

tools.label: Tools
tools.description: Functions the model may call, as a JSON array: [{"type": "function", "name": "...", "description": "...", "parameters": {...}}]. Up to 128.

additionalFields.label: Additional Fields
additionalFields.description: Any other request body fields from the Groq API reference, as a JSON object. The dedicated inputs above override keys set here.

groq_list_models.label: List Models
groq_list_models.description: List the models available to your Groq account.

groq_get_model.label: Get Model
groq_get_model.description: Get the details of one Groq model.

modelId.label: Model
modelId.description: Groq model ID, e.g. "openai/gpt-oss-20b". Use List Models to find the IDs on this account.
